events.title: The Copper Kettle Set to Simmer
events.summary: Jorge and Marissa set the heirloom copper pot over a low steady flame in New Jersey, beginning years of disciplined saving, career climbs, and late-night planning.

events.title: Birth of the Six-Year-Old Oracle
events.summary: Clara arrives, transforming the quest from an abstract gold-pile race into a search for a childhood full of parks, dancing, friends, and unicorn-bright mornings.

events.title: Forging of Garbanzo
events.summary: Jorge assembles Garbanzo out of brass rings and four emerald GPU star-crystals to track family vaults every morning at ten, inadvertently baking in the Double-Counting Bug.

events.title: Poki Crosses the Silver Wall
events.summary: Poki departs peacefully past the Silver Wall, leaving behind a calm starlight presence and a protective knack for knocking bad brochures off tables.

events.title: The Kettle Rattles and the Loom Creeps
events.summary: The Automaton Loom swirls through the Amber Terminal Citadel while Clara pins up a crayon portrait of Papa without a screen, triggering the war-table reckoning on the Brass Scale.

events.title: The Iberian Gauntlet and the Valladolid Discovery
events.summary: Armed with Cadastral Spectacles and the Compass of Living Streets, the family defeats the Mirage Brokers and discovers a sunlit, neighbor-rich home in the Valladolid valley.

events.title: The Battle of the Atlantic Storm-Bridge and the Resignation Seal
events.summary: After patching Garbanzo mid-storm to defeat Lord Double-Count's Hydra and resisting the Someday Siren's final March-bonus lure, Jorge stamps the Resignation Seal and the Golden Garbanzo blooms.

events.title: The Crossing and the First Free Morning
events.summary: Following a joyous farewell cocido madrileño feast with extended family, the Garbanzo Family crosses the ocean and claims a crisp, unhurried Tuesday morning in Spain.
